title: 65번 손실의 저주파 제곱 오차 보정: 관측 일치 손실과 저주파·고주파 손실 분리
registered: 2026-10-28, before any training of this experiment
hypothesis: 65 (L1 + 0.46 spectral) lowered QB SAM by 0.100 deg (3 seeds) but missed v2.3 on the PSNR noise threshold (+0.028 dB) and the FR observation ratio (1.43). 68 showed that 91% of the SAM gain is in the high band and that the WV2 PSNR loss of 65 (-0.277 dB) is entirely low band; 66 showed that making the output consistent with the observation raises RR PSNR by about 0.04 dB. L1 estimates a median and does not keep the linear constraint D(y) = MS that a mean (MSE) keeps (66). Restoring a squared error on the low band should keep the high-band SAM gain while removing the low-band drift.

arms.C2MS_L1SO: 65 loss unchanged (L1 + 1.0 x coarse L1 + 0.46 x spectral) + lambda_O x mean (D_p(y) - D_p(GT))^2 on the original pair (patch phase p) and on the 2x coarser pair (phase 2, weight 1.0)
arms.C2MS_SPLIT: k_S x mean (L(y - GT))^2 + mean |H(y - GT)| on the original pair and on the 2x coarser pair (weight 1.0), + 0.46 x spectral on the original pair; L1 is removed from the low band

arm_labels.C2MS_SPLIT: 저주파 제곱 오차 + 고주파 L1 + 분광

loss: C2MS_L1SO: per-pixel L1 + 500.0 x mean (D_p(y - GT))^2 (patch phase p) + 0.46 x spectral on the original pair, and L1 + 500.0 x mean (D(y - GT))^2 (phase 2) on the 2x coarser pair with weight 1.0; C2MS_SPLIT: 431.5 x mean (L(y - GT))^2 + mean |(y - GT) - L(y - GT)| on both pairs (coarse weight 1.0) + 0.46 x spectral on the original pair; history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold the arm reconstruction loss (without the spectral term)

operators.D_p: 54 Wald MS operator of the training sensor (per-band MS MTF, 41 taps, replicate border) followed by x4 decimation at phase p; on original pairs p is the patch's own phase, on coarse pairs p = phase 2 (the coarse MS is made that way)
operators.patch_phase: the training patches carry flips/rotations, so the decimation phase differs per patch: (1,2), (2,1) or (2,2) on QB. With the patch phase, D_p(GT) equals the given MS inside the 5-pixel LR margin to 2.3e-12 DN (256 QB patches); at the fixed phase 2 the interior mismatch is 10.6 DN RMS, max 204 DN. The phase of every train/validation patch is computed once in the runtime preparation (smallest interior mismatch of 16 phases) and stored with its SHA-256 in the data manifest; preflight fails if any patch's interior mismatch exceeds 1e-6 DN
operators.border: the observation term uses D_p(GT) instead of the given MS, which is identical inside the margin and avoids the border pixels where the patch crop and the full-image observation differ
operators.L: per-band MS MTF blur of the training sensor at full resolution (54 gen_mtf, ratio 4, 41 taps, replicate border, no decimation), the same low band as experiments 60 and 68; H = I - L

loss_weights.rule: same principle as the 65 spectral weight: equal gradient strength at a converged output. On 256 evenly spaced QB training patches (8 batches of 32) at the archived 65 C2MS_L1S QB seed 42 output, lambda_O = |grad L1_LF| / |grad OBS| and k_S = |grad L1_LF| / |grad MSE_LF| with L1_LF = mean |L(y - GT)| (batch means; per batch 459-559 and 376-489). The 53 C2MS output gives 526 and 426 (reference). The same weights are used for every sensor, as 65 kept 0.46

training.structure: C2MS (54 Model('C2MS')), unchanged; parameters as C2MS
training.schedule: same as 65: 150 epochs, Adam, per-epoch cosine 1e-4 -> 1e-6, batch 32 (micro 32), AMP FP16 core, loss terms in FP32, cuDNN deterministic, TF32 off, channels_last
training.data: QB and WV3 train/validation of 54; 2x coarser pairs by 54 CoarsePairs (cache reused from C:/CtrS-p59/run after hash check)
training.selection: original-scale validation MSE minimum (epoch 0 included), as 53-65
training.implementation: 65 trainer with only the reconstruction-loss expressions replaced at fixed, exactly matched locations (as 63/65/67); preflight checks the patch phases, that each loss term matches its formula on random tensors, and the initial weights of seed 42 equal 54 C2MS
training.device: server RTX 3060 Ti, one run at a time, separate runtime folder

references.note: the post-hoc projection numbers of 66 are reported only as the observation ceiling; they are not a comparable model result

comparability: training-only change; inference is one forward pass of one model with inputs PAN, LMS, MS; no projection, ensemble, sensor metadata or test-time adjustment. Transfer (WV2) uses the WV3 model unchanged

1_screen.cost: about 2.7 h per run (67), about 11 h in all
1_screen.evaluation: RR, RR2, FR_WALD, FR observation (v2.3) and the 67 detail indices (detail energy, injected detail ratio, band bias); QB against 53 C2MS s42 with the fixed QB RR2 reference; WV3 and WV2 transfer against 54 C2MS s42

gate.QB: FR observation ratio <= 1.10, RR SAM <= -0.07 deg (70% of the 65 gain), RR PSNR >= +0.04 dB
gate.WV3: FR observation ratio <= 1.10, RR SAM <= -0.05 deg, RR PSNR >= 0
gate.choice: if both arms pass, the one with the lower QB validation SAM goes on (C2MS_L1SO on a tie); test is not used to choose between passing arms
gate.fail: report; if the observation ratio stays above 1.10 while the training-scale term is met, the constraint does not carry to the FR scale and an observation-consistent output layer becomes the next design

2_repeat.runs: the chosen arm on QB seeds 43, 44 and GF2/WV3 seeds 42-44 (WV2 transfer)
2_repeat.judgement: paired 3-seed v2.3 per sensor against the same-seed C2MS (53 QB, 54 GF2/WV3), noise threshold 0.04 dB; QB RR2 against the fixed reference; baseline replacement needs a QB 3-seed improvement and the user's decision

limits: single-seed screen; the RR/FR test was reused in earlier exploration; the loss weights are matched at a converged output, so the early-training balance differs; validation has no FR scale, so the observation ratio is judged on test only; the patch phases on WV3 are computed in the runtime preparation (only QB was checked locally)
constraints: training starts after the user approval of 2026-10-28; archived checkpoints are read only; one GPU job at a time
precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0; earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as C2MS)
ema: EMA (beta 0.99) recorded as in 58, reported only; the main result uses the validation-MSE-selected regular weights

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data)

sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS (QB, WV3; WV2 for the transfer test); evaluation at phase 2; the training observation term uses the per-patch phase table
queue_order: QB first (the judgement sensor), then WV3 with the WV2 transfer; the queue can be stopped after any run
control_policy: No new control run: the archived same-seed C2MS (53 QB, 54 WV3) is the official control and 65 C2MS_L1S the reference, trained with the same data, schedule and trainer family; the QB RR2 item uses the fixed 57 C2MS seed 42 reference (judgement_vs_references C2MS_57)
